actor.description: A domain expert reviewing a finite-state transition comparison.

scope.description: The declared direct-support coordinate of the external finite-state comparison.

objective.statement: Determine whether the observed direct-support difference warrants bounded follow-up evidence.

constraints.statement: No candidate is an execution command and no action is authorized by this context.

time.basis: The two source snapshots bound the comparison.

authority.description: Declared review authority for this bounded diagnostic comparison.

uncertainty_conditions: A mismatch is not a certified defect.
Post-action outcomes require a new audit.
evaluator_qualification_note: Qualification is declared for this finite-state review only; it is not a general domain certificate.
negative_boundary: The context does not establish reference truth, severity, action correctness, or authorization.
